verdict.rationale: Alloy's own docs say workflows can run on a schedule as Portfolio workflows, and that transaction monitoring can run at scheduled times. That is a first-party recurring-execution capability, but the evidence is only two brief mentions. Nothing describes how schedules are set up or managed, and webhooks and Journeys are event-driven rather than scheduled. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule configuration (frequency/cron, time windows), any API or programmatic way to create or manage schedules, run history for scheduled jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Workflows can run in real time as part of a Journey evaluating an incoming application, or on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow
Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity
